reviews.author: Tiffani Coley
reviews.text: Are you still reading reviews!!! Stop ! Here is your team for all your plumbing needs! Jamie and his team went beyond measure to address all our plumbing needs.. an aged 70’s home is is back up and running properly… Thank you Cobia Plumbers for your support addressing all our needs in a timely manner!

reviews.author: Maddie Temple
reviews.text: Jamie came out to give us an estimate for our faucet installation and was able to set up our sink/faucet a couple hours later!! He also plugged our gas stove back up for us. He was very quick and professional and very friendly along with the other man that came with him (I can’t remember his name)!! They have great prices for the quality of work that they do and I 100% recommend them! We will be using them for future plumbing!

reviews.author: Katasha Jarrin
reviews.text: Jamie and his co-worker were very professional, kind and knowledgeable. He came to my home to fix leak in my water pipes underneath my house. He jumped right in to fix the issue. It took them over 2 hours to fix the issue but he made sure before he left. I no longer had the problem. He informed me on everything he was doing and what the issue was. I would never use anyone else again. His prices are the best I have come across in the city and I have used other plumbers before.

reviews.author: Michaela Garrett
reviews.text: Fast, efficient, and very affordable! Jamie and his assistant were super friendly and professional. We had an unexpected leak coming from our water heater connection and started to have water damage in our walls. On-Time Plumbing swooped in and saved the day. Jamie couldn’t have been more helpful and informative. I highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Amanda K
reviews.text: Jamie with On Time Plumbing is the BEST!! I have worked with him several times and when I called this week needing a drain unclogged, they unfortunately didn't have any openings, but, he called me the next day to tell me they had a cancellation!! He was prompt, professional, quickly resolved the issue and explained what steps we could take to prevent future clogs. He is truly awesome and I highly recommend On Time Plumbing! Prices are good and they email an invoice where you can pay directly from the invoice, very simple!

reviews.author: Rebecca Lambert
reviews.text: Jamie is phenomenal. I’ve had ongoing issues with my water pipe from the meter to my house. I have had multiple services come out from my home warranty and decided to drop it and just find my own plumber. He was amazing, remains in constant communication and does solid work. When it finally came time to replace the water line I did not hesitate on who I knew I was going to call. His name is saved in my phone. He remembered me and my house and came out immediately, did an assessment, and gave me an estimate. Even though it was a rainy week he ensured whatever work he could do he did. He kept in contact with me and even checked on the house to make sure I turned off the water so it wasn’t running while I was at work. Wish I found him sooner, could’ve saved a lot a money!! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Sandy Scarboro
reviews.text: Jaimie very quickly diagnosed where the clog in my pipe was located.He was professional and quickly cleaned up a pretty disgusting mess in my front yard. He was friendly and wore protective covers on his feet while he was in the house. He also drove down the street and unclogged my mom’s toilet. His prices were very reasonable.

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: Amazing service for a great price. Called because my gate valve for my main shut off broke, he came out within 30 min and fixed it immediately. Jamie was super friendly and informative. Showing me how to fix things on my own and telling me how to save money in the future. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kala S
reviews.text: This is the first time I've written a review immediately after a transaction. The price was very reasonable, he came out the day I called and the service was 5-star. Jamie was awesome, very professional and really great people skills! I have some more work I need done and will definitely be calling On Time for anymore plumbing work I need. Thanks Jamie, I really appreciate you, bruh!

reviews.author: James C
reviews.text: I was initially a little skeptical of calling a plumber with this few reviews, especially when they were all 5 star. From all my bad past experiences I thought there was no way a plumber could be this good. Boy was I wrong! Our 14 year old water heater finally decided to bite the bucket Tuesday afternoon. I initially called another company that is larger and has done work for us before. This other company came out Wednesday morning and was very polite, however when they told us the cost to replace the old one would be about $1600 and they could put it in that day we kindly refused. I called several other plumbing companies but no one could come out until Friday at the earliest. Finally around 5:30pm I called On Time Plumbing and spoke with Jamie and I asked if there would be any way he could come out Thursday to do a water heater replacement. He assured me he could and said they would be here around 2:00pm. I was skeptical that they would actually show up On Time but sure enough at almost 1400 on the dot they rang our doorbell. Jamie was a consummate professional who had the old water out and the new one installed in under two hours. He was very well organized, had a neat appearance and charged us almost $800 less than the other company quoted us! Believe the hype, this company is top notch and you will not find a better plumber in the area.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.text: He parked in the driveway so I had to park my car in the street. That's just a small annoyance. He asked for the $85 service fee payment as soon as he arrived. I've had a couple previous claims through my home warranty and I paid after they assessed the issue. I told him this and expressed concern about paying the fee and then him just leaving without doing anything. It wasn't until after I said this that he decided to get on the phone with the home warranty company. He said they wouldn't answer his call so he would just transfer the claim to another plumbing company, and he left. I'm glad I didn't pay the service fee when he asked for it... I've had this issue for over a month already and had to escalate the claim because the first company never responded. Now I have to go through this process all over again and coordinate around my work schedule. This was a huge inconvenience.

reviews.author: Sam Montoya
reviews.text: Very professional and was able to replace my broken water heater the sameday. Jamie worked with me and made payment very easy. My tenant now has hot water again and we are very happy with choosing on time plumbing. Will use them again!

reviews.author: Tina Cravens
reviews.text: Last week we discovered that our water main to our home had been crushed as the result of a remodeling crew parking on our yard. I contacted On-Time Plumbing and Jamie swiftly came to the rescue. He immediately started to dig and located the main. He made the repair in a timely manner as well as repaired our yard. Jamie was top-notch, professional, and personable. We are very grateful for his services.

reviews.author: Maylin Castillo
reviews.text: I contacted this company like 3 times over the span of a week because I had a plumbing issue and they had great reviews, so I wanted to get a quote from them to see if they could fix it. I was unable to reach them any of the times I called, so I ended up finding someone else to help me. Then a guy called me back and he got mad at me when I told him that I already found someone else and he said that he was going to block my number. He was really rude. I didn't do anything to bother them, I just needed a service. That's not a way to treat a customer. I'm a Real Estate investor and I need plumbers very frequently, so, they lost a good potential customer.

reviews.author: Harrison Graves
reviews.text: My wife and I had a couple of hours before our home was being photographed for it’s listing as we are about to move to Colorado in about a month. During those prior hours I was battling a clog in my kitchen sink drain and the floor was covered in dirty water, the counters were filled with dishes, and I was finished with snaking the drain again and again and again. I decided to listen to my wife and call somebody. After scouring the variety of businesses and calling down the line; On-Time Plumbing Services was the first to give me confidence that this problem was going to be fixed. The two gentlemen that came out to my house (Jamie and his partner) showed up about 10 minutes after I called, and they were ready to work immediately. (They chose to take my call during their lunch break while they still had their hot food in the van.) They assessed my sink’s issue, and quickly went through their motions to solve it. They worked together as a team and were incredibly pleasant to be around; SOLID family guys and hard workers. They let me watch what they were doing and they even taught me some tricks for my own personal knowledge. They knew what they were doing throughout the entire process. Everything was fixed beautifully, no more clog, sink functions great, and I now know what to do with the problem I had because of these professional and genuine plumbers. Call them before anyone else if you live in the Fayetteville area and need a reliable, personable, affordable, fast and an overall awesome experience from a local family business.

reviews.author: Greta Elliott
reviews.text: I contacted On Time Plumbing, Mr Jamie was able to arrive at my home that morning assess the problem which was a clogged main sewer line. I appreciate the quick response, contacting me and keeping me informed on the situation and getting the drain cleared for a reasonable price. Thank you Jamie! I will be using them again.

reviews.author: D McIver
reviews.text: On-Time plumbing is definitely ON-TIME in every since of the word. First time I used them it was in the middle of the night! They showed up in less than 20min with no problem. The second time was not an emergency so I was able to make appointment and he pulled up 5 min before our appointment! His does great work and every interaction is professional. In this day and time it’s difficult to find companies that have all of those qualities. As long as I’m in the Cumberland county area we will use On-Time plumbing! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jon Spraggins
reviews.text: After my old water heater failed spectacularly, On-Time Plumbing was quick to answer my call and replace my water heater on the same day. They took the time to explain all the things I can do to prolong the life of the new water heater. I appreciate their quick and professional work.

reviews.author: Win Win
reviews.text: Very impressed with my first experience with On-Time Plumbing Services LLC. He was prompt and very efficient. He checked all toilets and only one needed repair. Thanks for not dreaming up a repair. I appreciate the professional services and GREAT repair.

reviews.author: Tony Clark
reviews.text: Very very professional and worry free contractor. His work is perfect and within budget. I couldn’t be happier with his response time and attention to detail .

reviews.author: Danielle Stalker
reviews.text: I NEVER write reviews, but Jamie was awesome! I came home from work on Friday afternoon to my hot water heater flooding my garage. I called several companies and left messages which were ignored. I got up on Saturday and called On Time Plumbing around 1130. Jamie was at my house by 1330 and I had hot water by 1430. To top it off, he charged me less than he quoted me. I will be using this company for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Angela Murdock
reviews.text: We called them about 630pm (after hours) and they were at our house by 715pm. They had our clogged pipes fixed within 30 minutes of getting here. They do amazing work. Will highly recommend them and we will only use On Time Plumbing in the future. Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Nathan Derewecki
reviews.text: I hired them to fix a sink that I've been having issues with for quite some time. Not only did he fix what I called about, but also an additional problem . All in all, he was very courteous, knowledgeable, good at what he does, great price for the work, and was able to get here when I needed him here. If I have any other plumbing issues, this is the guy I'll be calling!

reviews.author: Gloria Barton
reviews.text: I, Gloria Barton would like to thank O-Time Plumbing Services LLC for an outstanding plumbing job that they did at 2814 Prioress Drive, Fayetteville NC. They were on time. I will pass this information on to others. Thank you to allowing this company provide me this service. Sign, Gloria Barton, July 1, 2024

reviews.author: Courtney Murray
reviews.text: Hired for our non-working water heater. He was AMAZING. He went to the home and realized it was nothing serious- no charge to evaluate- on time and worked around our crazy schedule. He is our new go-to guy for all plumbing needs! Hire- you won't regret!

reviews.author: Carol Hayden
reviews.text: Called them for a second opinion after first having a franchise plumber made a costly estimate. At the prices they quoted, another plumber was for peace of mind. However, the On Time Plumbing man diagnosed (correctly) that I had messed with my water settings and that the fix wasn't as drastic as the first plumber thought. He pointed out where my old hardware was the base of the issue. He worked efficiently to solve the problem. Afterward, he advised me how to use the fix to save money. Even after the 'come out charge' of the first plumber, I saved more with this company.

reviews.author: Shannon Boyer
reviews.text: Great company and the price was far cheaper then some of the big company competitors. Replaced my kitchen plumbing pipes all the way to the water run off underground. MY older house had galvanized pipes and had buildup under the house. Would definitely recommend and will use On Time Plumbing if i ever run into any other issues related to plumbing!

reviews.author: Amy Otero
reviews.text: I called Jamie this morning and he was able to come out the same day to fix my water heater. He was prompt, professional and affordable. Thank you Jamie for taking the time! I will call back when I need help again!

reviews.author: Nichole Hawley
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency, busted outdoor faucets. Jamie gave me a quote and was there the same afternoon and fixed us up for the price quoted. Fast, friendly, AFFORDABLE and I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Courtney Northcutt
reviews.text: Great customer service, Jamie was awesome, very polite, and knowledgeable. Found our leak within 20 min. Was in and out under 1.1 hours. Will be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Troy Page
reviews.text: Jamie is very professional. He does quality work he will take the to teach you why things should be a certain way. Very courteous and always ON TIME . My go to guy for life.

reviews.author: Lucas Dalgleish
reviews.text: Jamie at On Time Plumbing is responsive, professional and always beats every estimate I have had submitted by other plumbing companies. Great company!

reviews.author: Shyteria W
reviews.text: Called company several times to see if someone could come out to look at our plumbing issue/receive a quote. Finally spoke to someone and was told I would receive a call around noon to get scheduled; never received a callback.

reviews.author: Jeanette Jones
reviews.text: The gentleman was awesome. He took his time to educate me on the issue. He handled it professionally and honestly. Excellent customer service. I would definitely recommend this company if anyone is need of service!

reviews.author: Paul Tatum
reviews.text: On time plumbing went above and beyond the call of duty installing my hot water heater. The crew was at my house on time and finished the work in a timely matter. Best price in town.

reviews.author: Brian A
reviews.text: These guys tell you how it is, and they do the job right. They showed me what tools I’d need to do the job myself and they showed me showed me maintenance tips for my current plumbing. The price was very far and I will be keeping them on the fridge for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Mekesa Simpson
reviews.text: Jamie with On time plumbing was very professional. Found my problem, fixed it and told me exactly what I needed to do after. Will definitely be referring others.

reviews.author: Gloria Sawyer
reviews.text: This Company is A1. I was extremely satisfied with their performance. Honest, knowledgeable, professional and attentive to detail. I highly recommend On Time Plumbing.

reviews.author: Angele capel
reviews.text: On-Time plumbing has given us great service, been on time and very professional every time they had to come out. This is the only plumbing company in Fayetteville my family will use!

reviews.author: Garry Hawn
reviews.text: Fantastic service, especially in a emergency situation and after 5 o'clock. Jamie is the plumber to have on your contact list. He gets my highest recommendation.

reviews.author: anday Vanderpol
reviews.text: Jamie was fantastic! He thoroughly went over everything, advised on options, and was very quick with responding & getting the job done! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Lorinda Bertz
reviews.text: Would highly recommend this company. Very professional, and friendly. Was able to fix my plumbing problem. Thanks, Jamie!!

reviews.author: Wendy Mcphatter
reviews.text: On time is the best company I've used they were on time and offer great prices. I really appreciated that he was informative on the work he did for me.

reviews.author: Justin Crowley
reviews.text: Excellent customer service, fast repair. The cost was very good for the quality of work performed. Will be using this company again in the future.

reviews.author: Happy Hibler
reviews.text: Awesome company! Very professional and knowledgeable. Took time to explain all questions I had for him. I highly recommend this company. Keep up the good work!!

reviews.author: Sean Smith
reviews.text: I called these guys to help stop a leak from a busted pipe. The response time was very fast and the job was complete just as fast. Very friendly folks

reviews.author: Tina Owens
reviews.text: Great company, reasonable prices and professional. Would recommend this company for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Beverly N Lopez Rodriguez
reviews.text: Jamie was very quick, efficient and polite! Would recommend 100% to anyone in need of immediate service!

reviews.author: FoodieMoody
reviews.text: Ended up not needing my main turned off which was the main reason I called them over but the plumber still took the time out to show me where it was located and even dug it up for me.

reviews.author: Richard H
reviews.text: fixed my clean out full of baby wipes. super good service and cleaned up everything also. same day service also!! Thanks guys

reviews.author: kevin blakeney
reviews.text: Excellent work! Professional all the way.... Would definitely recommend him to friends and family!!!

reviews.author: Maurise Winston
reviews.text: Very rude customer service. I call to ask a question about services and as soon as I speak they hang up in my face
